=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Abathur's Slaphatur now displays as a critical hit.

=== Heroes: Alexstrasza ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Alexstrasza's Cleansing Flame to not provide Stasis frames at the correct time.

=== Heroes: Chromie ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Chromie's Once Again the First Time to provide a lower bonus for Echo mimic Sand Blast damage than Echo mimic Basic Attacks damage.

=== Heroes: Nazeebo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Nazeebo's Thing of the Deep to not give any Reward if picked when already having enough stacks.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Nazeebo's Vile Infection to not give any Reward if picked when already having enough stacks.

=== Heroes: Ragnaros ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the damage over time from Ragnaros's Explosive Rune in Molten Core to not behave as a damage over time effect.
